Reading physics through relations

An inspectable relational interface between perception and physical prediction. Pick a scene, choose a query, and switch the vocabulary rung: the forecast is made only from the facts listed on the right. Ground-truth CLEVRER states; fully inductive model (no object seen in training).

Scene

solid = in camera viewdashed = out of view (no new facts recorded while unseen) arrow = velocityred line = forecast cutoff

Forecast

Bars: model scores for the queried object's possible collision partners, softmax-normalized for display (not calibrated probabilities). The small grid in each query shows the true partner's rank on each rung (1 = top).

What the model sees: history facts up to the cutoff

The history is treated as a set: shuffling event order leaves every prediction unchanged (identical test MRR on all four rungs). Temporal content enters through the vocabulary, e.g. heading_toward with a constant-velocity look-ahead. Tinted chips are facts this rung adds over the previous one.
